explanation: PR 21 adds src/search/hypomap: a checksum-verified loader for the pinned HypoMap export (atlas.ts), Spatial and By dataset views, a co-expression explorer that calls the loopback comparison service, and a CSV preview. portalCards mounts them only behind VITE_HYPOMAP_EXPRESSION and VITE_HYPOMAP_COEXPRESSION, both off by default. The catalog summary and start-here references now name the HypoMap views and atlas.ts.
